title: •I Am Your Father
caption: •I Am Your Father (V)
game_text: If Vader just won a battle or duel against Luke, deploy on table; opponent loses 1 Force. During your control phase, if Vader present at a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. If Vader just lost, place this Immediate Effect in Used Pile.
lore: “Search your feelings, you _know_ it to be true.”

notes: Unique. Banner IMMEDIATE EFFECT with NO grabber box at its right end → grabber false (printed base is already an Immediate Effect). No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. The crop shows a stray glyph tail above the heading (bottom of the previous slip's number), not part of the title. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes around the quote (wiki straight single quotes) and 'know' printed in italics (wiki plain) — confirmed on the 745 px V5 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible. Modern: V5-D-iamyourfather.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 5 remake); 'V5-D-iamyourfather ai.gif' (AI-art alternate) and VB2 -pre (350) also exist, not downloaded.
